cameraUnsupported: No camera available with this connection.
temperatureHistory: Temperature history: nozzle in orange, bed in blue
temperatureGaps: Dotted lines: sparse or interrupted readings.
manualSpool: Informational entry in FabCore: does not load or unload filament.
spoolInvalid: Enter a valid material without control characters.
notApplicable: Not applicable to this machine type.
cloudReadOnly: Read-only cloud connection: machine commands unavailable.
preparedProject: Start uses the project prepared on the machine.
controlsUnavailable: Unable to read controls. Refresh to retry.
confirmStop: The current job will be cancelled. Check the machine before confirming.
confirmStart: Check that the work area is clear and the prepared project is correct.

outcomes.accepted: Command accepted; execution still needs to be checked on the machine.
outcomes.executed: Command executed according to the protocol; check readings.
outcomes.reset-alarm: Stop confirmed: laser in alarm, motion and power at zero.

errors.command-rejected: Machine rejected the command. Check its logs.
errors.command-unconfirmed: Result unknown. Check the machine and logs before sending another command.
errors.heater-unconfirmed: Heating target was not confirmed. Check temperatures and logs.
errors.bambu-authorization: Bambu command not authorized. On LAN, check the machine developer mode and logs.
errors.control-invalid: Control unavailable or invalid parameters for the current state.
errors.command-state: The machine state no longer allows this command.
errors.rate: Commands sent too quickly. Wait before retrying.
